messages.subject: CPD lunch & learn: SDLT and TOGC update — Thurs 13 March, 12:30
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

The real estate group is running a CPD lunch & learn on recent SDLT and TOGC developments on Thursday 13 March at 12:30 in the Bishopsgate boardroom (sandwiches provided). One CPD hour. Please reply to me if you'd like a place.

Best,
Donna
